clips.send: The Louisiana Purchase. Bought from France, 1803. $15 million — about 3 cents an acre. President Thomas Jefferson only wanted the port of New Orleans. Napoleon, short of money for his wars in Europe, offered the whole territory. It roughly doubled the size of the country — about 828,000 sq mi, parts of 15 future states. Jefferson sent Meriwether Lewis and William Clark (the Corps of Discovery) to explore it, 1804–1806.

clips.send: Texas Annexation. Annexed, 1845 (independent Republic of Texas 1836–1845). Joined by vote of Congress; Mexico did not accept it. American settlers, invited by Mexico in the 1820s, outnumbered Tejanos (Mexican Texans) by the 1830s. Many brought enslaved people, although Mexico had abolished slavery in 1829. Texas won independence in 1836 (the Alamo, then victory at San Jacinto). Annexation in 1845 led straight to war with Mexico, because both countries claimed the land between the Nueces River and the Rio Grande.

clips.send: The Mexican Cession. From Mexico, Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo (1848), after the Mexican–American War. $15 million (plus up to $3.25 million in claims). The Mexican–American War (1846–1848) ended with US troops in Mexico City. Mexico lost about half of its territory — today’s California, Nevada, Utah and parts of four more states. About 80,000–100,000 Mexican citizens living there could become US citizens; many later lost their land in courts.

clips.send: The United States in 1783. From Britain, Treaty of Paris (1783). Won in the Revolutionary War. The Treaty of Paris ended the American Revolution. Britain recognised US independence. The new border ran west to the Mississippi River, north to the Great Lakes, and south to Spanish Florida. Land between the Appalachians and the Mississippi was home to many Native nations — Shawnee, Miami, Cherokee, Creek and others — who had not signed the treaty.

clips.send: Florida. From Spain, Adams–Onís Treaty (1819). US paid $5 million of its citizens’ claims against Spain. After raids across the border and General Andrew Jackson’s invasion in 1818, Spain agreed to give up Florida. The treaty also drew the border between the US and Spanish Mexico all the way to the Pacific. Seminole people in Florida later fought removal for decades.

clips.send: The Gadsden Purchase. Bought from Mexico, 1853. $10 million. The US wanted flat land south of the Gila River for a southern railroad to California. It completed the borders of the “lower 48” states. Next came Alaska (bought from Russia, 1867) and Hawaii (annexed 1898).

clips.send: Red River Basin. From Britain, Convention of 1818. Treaty — no payment. The US and Britain agreed that the border would run along the 49th parallel (49°N) from Lake of the Woods to the Rocky Mountains. The two countries also agreed to share the Oregon Country for the time being.

clips.send: Oregon Country. From Britain, Oregon Treaty (1846). Treaty — split at 49°N, no payment. From 1818 the US and Britain shared the Oregon Country. Thousands of American settlers arrived on the Oregon Trail from 1843. Some Americans shouted “Fifty-four forty or fight!” (54°40′N), but President Polk compromised at 49°N. The Chinook, Nez Perce, Cayuse and many other nations had lived here for thousands of years.

clips.send: 加兹登购地。从墨西哥购买 · 1853年。1000万美元。美国想得到吉拉河以南的平坦土地，修一条通往加利福尼亚的南方铁路。它让美国本土48州的边界最终定型。此后又有阿拉斯加（1867年从俄国购买）和夏威夷（1898年兼并）。

clips.send: 兼并得克萨斯。兼并 · 1845年（1836—1845年为独立的得克萨斯共和国）。由国会表决并入；墨西哥不承认。19世纪20年代，墨西哥邀请美国移民来得克萨斯；到30年代，他们的人数已超过当地的墨西哥裔居民（Tejanos）。很多人还带来了被奴役的黑人，而墨西哥1829年已废除奴隶制。1836年得克萨斯获得独立（阿拉莫之战，随后圣哈辛托之战获胜）。1845年美国兼并得克萨斯，直接引发美墨战争——两国都声称拥有努埃塞斯河与格兰德河之间的土地。

clips.send: 佛罗里达。来自西班牙 ·《亚当斯-奥尼斯条约》（1819年）。美国承担本国公民对西班牙的500万美元索赔。边境冲突不断，安德鲁·杰克逊将军1818年率军进入佛罗里达后，西班牙同意放弃佛罗里达。条约还划定了美国与西属墨西哥之间一直到太平洋的边界。佛罗里达的塞米诺尔人后来为反抗被迁移坚持斗争了几十年。

clips.send: 1783年的美国。来自英国 ·《巴黎和约》（1783年）。独立战争胜利后获得。《巴黎和约》结束了美国独立战争，英国承认美国独立。美国的边界向西到密西西比河，北到五大湖，南到西班牙的佛罗里达。阿巴拉契亚山脉与密西西比河之间，生活着肖尼人、迈阿密人、切罗基人、克里克人等许多印第安部族，他们并没有在和约上签字。

clips.send: 墨西哥割让地。来自墨西哥 ·《瓜达卢佩-伊达尔戈条约》（1848年），美墨战争之后。1500万美元（另承担最多325万美元的索赔）。美墨战争（1846—1848年）以美军攻占墨西哥城告终。墨西哥失去了约一半国土——今天的加利福尼亚、内华达、犹他以及另外四个州的一部分。生活在这里的约8万至10万墨西哥人可以成为美国公民，但后来很多人在官司中失去了土地。

clips.send: 路易斯安那购地。从法国购买 · 1803年。1500万美元——每英亩约3美分。杰斐逊总统本来只想买下新奥尔良港。拿破仑急需战争经费，干脆把整片土地都卖给了美国。美国国土面积大约扩大了一倍——约82.8万平方英里，后来分出了15个州的全部或部分。杰斐逊派刘易斯和克拉克率领“发现军团”（Corps of Discovery）在1804—1806年考察这片土地。

clips.send: 俄勒冈地区。来自英国 ·《俄勒冈条约》（1846年）。条约以北纬49度划分，没有付款。1818年起，美英共同占有俄勒冈地区。1843年起，成千上万的美国移民沿俄勒冈小道来到这里。有美国人高喊“北纬54度40分，不然就开战！”，但波尔克总统最后同意以北纬49度为界。奇努克人、内兹佩尔塞人、卡尤斯人等许多部族已在这里生活了几千年。
